entries.title: Matthew 1:1
segments: ¶The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the Son of David, the Son of Abraham:

entries.title: Matthew 1:2
segments: Abraham begot Isaac, Isaac begot Jacob, and Jacob begot Judah and his brothers.

entries.title: Matthew 1:3
segments: Judah begot Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez begot Hezron, and Hezron begot Ram.

entries.title: Matthew 1:4
segments: Ram begot Amminadab, Amminadab begot Nahshon, and Nahshon begot Salmon.

entries.title: Matthew 1:5
segments: Salmon begot Boaz by Rahab, Boaz begot Obed by Ruth, Obed begot Jesse,

entries.title: Matthew 1:6
segments: and Jesse begot David the king. David the king begot Solomon by her [who had been the wife] of Uriah.

entries.title: Matthew 1:7
segments: Solomon begot Rehoboam, Rehoboam begot Abijah, and Abijah begot Asa.

entries.title: Matthew 1:8
segments: Asa begot Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat begot Joram, and Joram begot Uzziah.

entries.title: Matthew 1:9
segments: Uzziah begot Jotham, Jotham begot Ahaz, and Ahaz begot Hezekiah.

entries.title: Matthew 1:10
segments: Hezekiah begot Manasseh, Manasseh begot Amon, and Amon begot Josiah.

entries.title: Matthew 1:11
segments: Josiah begot Jeconiah and his brothers about the time they were carried away to Babylon.

entries.title: Matthew 1:12
segments: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jeconiah begot Shealtiel, and Shealtiel begot Zerubbabel.

entries.title: Matthew 1:13
segments: Zerubbabel begot Abiud, Abiud begot Eliakim, and Eliakim begot Azor.

entries.title: Matthew 1:14
segments: Azor begot Zadok, Zadok begot Achim, and Achim begot Eliud.

entries.title: Matthew 1:15
segments: Eliud begot Eleazar, Eleazar begot Matthan, and Matthan begot Jacob.

entries.title: Matthew 1:16
segments: And Jacob begot Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus who is called Christ.

entries.title: Matthew 1:17
segments: So all the generations from Abraham to David [are] fourteen generations, from David until the captivity in Babylon [are] fourteen generations, and from the captivity in Babylon until the Christ [are] fourteen generations.

entries.title: Matthew 1:18
segments: ¶Now the birth of Jesus Christ was as follows: After His mother Mary was betrothed to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Matthew 1:19
segments: Then Joseph her husband, being a just [man], and not wanting to make her a public example, was minded to put her away secretly.

entries.title: Matthew 1:20
segments: But while he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, "Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take to you Mary your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Matthew 1:21
segments: "And she will bring forth a Son, and you shall call His name JESUS, for He will save His people from their sins."

entries.title: Matthew 1:22
segments: So all this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying:

entries.title: Matthew 1:23
segments: "Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and bear a Son, and they shall call His name Immanuel," which is translated, "God with us."

entries.title: Matthew 1:24
segments: Then Joseph, being aroused from sleep, did as the angel of the Lord commanded him and took to him his wife,

entries.title: Matthew 1:25
segments: and did not know her till she had brought forth her firstborn Son. And he called His name JESUS.
